nodes_added.basis: PHB p118 separately names song and playing as the charm vehicle and as the harpy and shrieker countermeasure.

nodes_added.label: Shrieker

nodes_added.label: Stringed Instrument
nodes_added.basis: PHB p118 requires a bard always to have a mundane stringed instrument; it is distinct from magic-item identities.
